global.font_body: 'Noto Sans JP', 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', sans-serif

home.layout: Thin utility bar, red masthead, horizontal category tab scroller, then 5-column news grid with thumbnails as hero, secondary 3-column featured stories, and right sidebar stacking stock ticker, weather, sports scores, TV schedule and ad units.

politics.layout: Two-column: main column with lead Diet story, dated article list with bylines and comment counts; right sidebar with politician index, election widget, and ads.

economy.layout: Top stock ticker strip, lead business stories in 3-column grid, dense market data table mid-page, corporate earnings list, real estate sub-section and sidebar with currency rates.

international.layout: World map nav with region tabs (Asia/Americas/Europe/Middle East), 4-column story grid per region, foreign correspondent column rail, and right ad/sidebar stack.

culture.layout: Magazine-style hero feature, 3-column reviews (film/music/books) with star ratings, event calendar table, food and travel thumbnails strip, sidebar with bestseller list.
